scenes.headline: Your coding agent thinks out loud.
scenes.support: The reasoning is already in the log.
sentences: A coding agent thinks in full sentences, and shows you almost none of them.
Reezyn reads that thinking, and says it out loud.

scenes.headline: It waits for the pause.
scenes.support: 700 ms debounce · 9 s stale · 30 s dedupe
sentences: Agents fire tool calls in bursts.
Reezyn waits for the pause, keeps the one thought worth hearing, and drops the backlog.

scenes.headline: Six stations, no model in the middle.
sentences: Every event takes the same path.
An adapter reads the session log, the coalescer picks the burst, the cleaner strips the code, and Kokoro speaks it locally.

scenes.headline: Whatever you drive, it listens.
sentences: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, OpenCode and Freebuff are watched directly.
Anything else can emit an event of its own.

scenes.headline: Cleaned for the ear.
sentences: Code is stripped, paths go, and snake case becomes words.
A technical shorthand is spelled out, two sentences at most are kept, and if there is no reasoning at all, it names the file instead.

scenes.headline: Calm, or brisk.
sentences: Nine voices, three paces, and language packs for English, Spanish and French.
A pack frames the agent's words in its own language, but it pronounces them, it does not translate them.

scenes.headline: The whole app is one menu.
sentences: The seedling in the menu bar is the interface: pause, skip, the last six lines, and a recap of the session.
The CC viewer floats the current line over your editor, and ignores the pointer until you hold Option.

scenes.headline: Ask again, hear what it settled.
sentences: Each project keeps a small ledger of what you asked and what the agent concluded.
Ask something you already settled, and Reezyn quotes the earlier answer first, once per prompt, and at most once every ninety seconds.

scenes.headline: Reply without the keyboard.
scenes.support: on-device speech · nothing written to disk
sentences: Say Reezyn, and dictate.
It types the draft and never submits it.
Ready to send it, unless you end with send it now.
When a turn ends, it speaks the answer and reopens the microphone.

scenes.headline: The session comes with you.
sentences: Remote access publishes the same session to your phone, over Tailscale, and nowhere else.
Live lines, allow and deny, replies by text or voice, read aloud, and a recap.

scenes.headline: Local by construction.
scenes.support: no cloud · no telemetry · no summary model
sentences: No cloud calls, no telemetry, no summary model.
Updates are checked against a checksum and the same Developer ID before a single byte is swapped in.

scenes.headline: Then it just talks.
scenes.support: free · open source · macOS 13 or later
sentences: Reezyn is free and open source, and installs in a minute.
Then it just talks.
